title: Is this match exhaustive?
subtitle: Toggle the arms and watch the compiler react
okText: Every possible Message value is handled by at least one arm. Adding a new variant to the enum later will make this match fail to compile until you handle it.
warnText: A _ arm matches everything, so the arms after it can never run. The compiler warns because it is almost always a bug.
errorText: Some variants have no arm. Rust refuses to compile a match that could fall through, so a forgotten case can never reach production.
guardText: Note that the guarded arm (if x == y) does not count: the compiler does not reason about guard conditions, so Move still needs an unguarded arm.
wildcardText: The _ wildcard makes the match exhaustive, but it also silences the compiler if a variant is added later. Prefer listing variants explicitly for enums you own.
